description: VeriCEMS channel registry defining verified real US EPA CAMPD hourly Part 75 channels (verified in Milestone P03 data card) and synthetic cross-check / physical telemetry channels.

channels.name: gross_load_mw
channels.description: Electrical gross load generated by the unit during the operating hour, reported under 40 CFR Part 75.

channels.name: steam_load_1000_lb_hr
channels.description: Steam output mass flow rate for steam-generating units (structurally null on electric-only utility units in CAMPD).

channels.name: heat_input_mmbtu
channels.description: Total thermal energy input from fuel combustion during the reporting hour (co-derived with CO2 Mass via Part 75 Appendix D/F/G).

channels.name: co2_mass_short_tons
channels.description: Reported carbon dioxide mass emitted during the operating hour (circularly related to Heat Input (mmBtu) under 40 CFR Part 75 Appendix F/G).

channels.name: co2_rate_short_tons_mmbtu
channels.description: Reported carbon dioxide emission rate per unit heat input (CO2 Mass / Heat Input) during the operating hour.

channels.name: so2_mass_lbs
channels.description: Reported sulfur dioxide mass emitted during the operating hour.

channels.name: nox_mass_lbs
channels.description: Reported nitrogen oxides mass emitted during the operating hour.

channels.name: op_time_fraction
channels.description: Fraction of the clock hour (0.00 to 1.00) during which the unit operated.

channels.name: synthetic_stack_o2_pct
channels.description: Synthetic stack flue-gas oxygen concentration (% dry volume) simulated from combustion stoichiometry and excess-air models; absent from hourly CAMPD CSVs.

channels.name: synthetic_flue_temp_c
channels.description: Synthetic stack flue-gas temperature (degrees Celsius) simulated as a function of thermal load and ambient baseline; absent from hourly CAMPD CSVs.

channels.name: synthetic_stack_flow_kscfm
channels.description: Synthetic stack volumetric flow rate (thousand standard cubic feet per minute) simulated from heat input and excess O2; absent from hourly CAMPD CSVs.

channels.name: synthetic_fuel_flow_mmbtu_indep
channels.description: Synthetic independent custody-transfer fuel meter / fuel ledger cross-check signal (mmBtu, also referenced as fuel_ledger_synthetic) with calibrated meter noise, used to break Part 75 CO2-vs-heat-input circularity.
